items.exampleEn: The actors were nervous before they went onstage.
Our school hired a DJ for the dance party.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校為舞會請了一位 DJ。

items.exampleEn: Tourists come here for the nightlife.
items.exampleZh: 觀光客為了夜生活來這裡。

items.exampleEn: I met an old friend during the intermission.
items.exampleZh: 我在中場休息時遇到一位老朋友。

items.exampleEn: Being a disc jockey is my dream job.
items.exampleZh: 當唱片騎師是我夢想中的工作。

items.exampleEn: Each video clip on this website is less than a minute long.
items.exampleZh: 這個網站上的每段短片都不到一分鐘。

items.sentenceEn: The play has a fifteen-minute intermission.
items.sentenceZh: 這齣戲有十五分鐘的中場休息。

items.audioEn: During the intermission, you can buy snacks in the hall but not take them inside.
items.audioZh: 中場休息時可以在大廳買點心，但不能帶進去。
items.questionZh: 中場休息時可以做什麼？
options: Take photos of the actors onstage
Meet the actors in the hall

items.sentenceEn: The band came onstage at nine o'clock.
The disc jockey asked everyone to dance.
items.sentenceZh: 唱片騎師請大家一起跳舞。

items.stemEn: Most young people enjoy the city's busy ____.
items.stemZh: 大部分年輕人喜歡這座城市熱鬧的夜生活。

items.stemEn: She posted a funny ____ of her dog online.
items.stemZh: 她在網路上貼了一段她家狗的搞笑短片。

items.passageEn: Last Friday, I went to a music show at the city theater. Before the show, a disc jockey played songs to get the crowd ready. Then the band came onstage, and the audience stood up and cheered for the guitarist. During the intermission, the DJ played more music, and I recorded a short video clip on my phone. After the show, my friends and I walked around the city to enjoy its famous nightlife. We got home after midnight.
items.passageZh: 上星期五，我去市立劇院看一場音樂表演。表演前，一位唱片騎師放歌讓觀眾進入狀況。接著樂團上台，觀眾都站起來為吉他手歡呼。中場休息時，DJ 又放了更多音樂，我用手機錄了一段短片。表演結束後，我和朋友們在城裡逛，享受這裡有名的夜生活。我們半夜過後才到家。

questions.questionZh: 中場休息時作者做了什麼？
options: 去買了一些點心和飲料

items.promptZh: 我表親在廣播電台當唱片騎師。
referenceEn: My cousin works as a disc jockey at a radio station.
My cousin is a disc jockey on the radio.
rubricZh: disc jockey 表示「唱片騎師、DJ」，例如 work as a disc jockey 等說法
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.promptZh: 這一區的夜生活到凌晨三點才結束。
referenceEn: The nightlife in this area doesn't end until three in the morning.
In this area, the nightlife goes on until three in the morning.
rubricZh: 用 nightlife 表示「夜生活」
「到凌晨三點才結束」可寫，例如 doesn't end until three in the morning、goes on until 3 a.m. 等
